label: Verification
title: Verification
description: Configure verification gates, understand setup defaults, and collect evidence that your application meets its spec.
code:
[commands]
typecheck = "bun tsc --noEmit"
test = "bun test"

[verify]
steps = ["types", "unit", "acceptance"]

[verify.types]
kind = "check"
command = "typecheck"
always = true

[verify.unit]
kind = "check"
command = "test"

[verify.acceptance]
kind = "agent"
skill = "verify-acceptance"
paths = ["web/**", "src/routes/**"]

[verify]
steps = ["acceptance"]

[verify.acceptance]
kind = "agent"
skill = "verify-acceptance"

[roles.default]
runtime = "codex"
model = "gpt-6.1-sol"

[roles.acceptance]
runtime = "codex"
model = "gpt-6.1-sol"

label: Working with your operator agent
title: Working with your operator agent
